4 import crypto from 'node:crypto';

12 export const REFINEMENT_SCHEMA = 'ecgberht-refinement-v1';
13 const DOCS = { 'PLAN.md': 'PLAN', 'DELIVERABLES.md': 'DELIVERABLES' };
14 const fail = (error, detail) => ({ ok: false, error, ...(detail ? { detail } : {}) });
15 const sha = bytes => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
16 const escape = value => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
17 const cell = value => escape(value).replace(/\|/g, '&#124;').replace(/[\r\n]/g, ' ');
18 const sourceCell = value => cell(value).replace(/[\\`*_[\]()]/g, character => '\\' + character);
19 const markers = key => [`<!-- ECGBERHT-MANAGED-${key} v1 begin -->`, `<!-- ECGBERHT-MANAGED-${key} v1 end -->`];

21 function contained(root, rel, exists = true) {
22   if (typeof rel !== 'string' || !rel || path.isAbsolute(rel) || /^[A-Za-z]:/.test(rel) || rel.split(/[\\/]/).includes('..')) throw Object.assign(new Error('Expected a contained relative path'), {code:'containment-refused'});
23   const realRoot = fs.realpathSync(root);
24   const abs = path.resolve(root, rel);
25   let ancestor = abs;
26   while (!fs.existsSync(ancestor)) ancestor = path.dirname(ancestor);
27   const resolved = fs.realpathSync(ancestor);
28   const inside = p => p === realRoot || p.startsWith(realRoot + path.sep);
29   if (!inside(resolved) || (exists && !fs.existsSync(abs))) throw Object.assign(new Error('Missing or escaping artifact'), {code:'containment-refused'});
30   if (fs.existsSync(abs) && !inside(fs.realpathSync(abs))) throw Object.assign(new Error('Escaping artifact'), {code:'containment-refused'});
31   return abs;
32 }

34 function readDocument(root, name) {
35   const abs = contained(root, name, false);
36   return fs.existsSync(abs) ? {exists:true, baseline:fs.readFileSync(abs,'utf8')} : {exists:false,baseline:''};

39 function splitManaged(text, key) {
40   const [begin,end] = markers(key);
41   const count = token => text.split(token).length - 1;
42   // Any partial/foreign version marker for this region must also be reconciled.
43   const mentions = (text.match(new RegExp(`<!--\\s*ECGBERHT-MANAGED-${key}\\b`, 'g')) || []).length;
44   if (!mentions) return {absent:true};
45   const start = text.indexOf(begin), stop = text.indexOf(end);
46   if (count(begin)!==1 || count(end)!==1 || mentions!==2 || stop<start) throw Object.assign(new Error('Managed markers are missing, duplicated or malformed'),{code:'managed-content-conflict'});
47   return {prefix:text.slice(0,start),region:text.slice(start,stop+end.length),suffix:text.slice(stop+end.length)};
48 }

50 function presentationMembers(slice, presentationId) {
51   const p = slice.presentations.find(p => p.id === presentationId || p.presentation_id === presentationId);
52   return p?.members || [];
53 }

55 export function renderRefinementDocument(state, name) {
56   const [begin,end] = markers(DOCS[name]);
57   const lines = [begin, `<!-- schema=${REFINEMENT_SCHEMA} campaign=${escape(state.adoption.campaign_id)} generation=${state.generation} -->`];
58   if (name === 'PLAN.md') lines.push('## Current slice work');
59   else lines.push('## START HERE — current work and earlier versions');
60   for (const slice of Object.values(state.slices)) {
61     const round = slice.round === 0 ? 'Initial draft' : `Refinement ${slice.round}`;
62     lines.push(`\n### ${cell(slice.title)} — ${round} · ${cell(slice.phase)} · ${slice.round} refinements`);
63     if (slice.depends_on?.length) lines.push(slice.depends_on.map(d=>`Foundation ${cell(d.slice_id)}: ${cell(d.state)} (${cell(d.presentation_id || 'not accepted')})`).join('; '));
64     lines.push('\n| What | Where | Date | Step |','|---|---|---|---|');
65     for (const [productId,revId] of Object.entries(slice.candidate)) {
66       const rev = slice.revisions[revId];
67       if (rev) lines.push(`| ${cell(productId)} — current ${round} | \`${rev.path}\` | ${cell(rev.at || state.last_event_at)} | ${cell(slice.step_id)} |`);
68     }
69     if (slice.accepted_presentation) lines.push(`\nAccepted presentation: ${cell(slice.accepted_presentation)}${slice.phase==='done'?' · Done':''}.`);
70     if (slice.presentations.length) {
71       lines.push('\n<details>','<summary>Earlier versions and presented rounds</summary>','');
72       for (const p of slice.presentations) {
73         const label = p.round===0 ? 'Initial draft' : `Refinement ${p.round}`;
74         lines.push(`**${label}** · ${cell(p.at)}${p.id===slice.accepted_presentation?' · accepted':''}`,'');
75         for (const m of p.members) lines.push(`- [${cell(m.product_id)}](${m.path.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/')})`);
76       }
77       lines.push('','</details>');
78     }
79   }
80   const handoffs = Object.values(state.producer_handoffs || {});
81   if (handoffs.length) {
82     lines.push('\n<details open>', '<summary>Completed work awaiting Steward review</summary>', '');
83     for (const handoff of handoffs.filter(item => item.status === 'pending_steward_review')) {
84       lines.push(`- ${cell(handoff.producer_kind)} ${sourceCell(handoff.source_ref)} — ${cell(handoff.step_id || 'slice not yet mapped')} · ${cell(handoff.terminal || 'outcome unknown')} · ${cell(handoff.freshness)} · ${cell(handoff.at)}`);
85       lines.push(`  Handoff: ${cell(handoff.handoff_id)}. Output inventory ${handoff.inventory_complete ? 'declared complete' : 'requires verification'}.`);
86     }
87     lines.push('', '</details>');
88   }
89   lines.push(end);
90   return lines.join('\n');
91 }

93 // The editable generation is only a lookup hint. Accept a historical block only
94 // when its complete rendering matches the corresponding authoritative prefix.
95 function matchesHistoricalRegion(events, name, region, currentState, prefixStates) {
96   if(typeof region!=='string') return false;
97   const prefix=`${markers(DOCS[name])[0]}\n<!-- schema=${REFINEMENT_SCHEMA} campaign=${escape(currentState.adoption.campaign_id)} generation=`;
98   if(!region.startsWith(prefix)) return false;
99   const match=/^([1-9][0-9]*) -->\n/.exec(region.slice(prefix.length));
100   if(!match) return false;
101   const generation=Number(match[1]);
102   if(!Number.isSafeInteger(generation) || String(generation)!==match[1] || generation>=currentState.generation) return false;
103   let state=prefixStates.get(generation);
104   if(!state) {
105     let ordinal=0;
106     for(let i=0;i<events.length;i++) if(events[i].kind==='refinement_update') {
107       if(++ordinal!==generation) continue;
108       state=foldRefinements(events.slice(0,i+1));
109       break;
110     }
111     if(!state || !state.managed || state.generation!==generation) return false;
112     prefixStates.set(generation,state);
113   }
114   return renderRefinementDocument(state,name)===region;
115 }

117 export function refinementProjectionStatus(root, roadmap) {
118   try {
119     const state=foldRefinements(roadmap.roadmap_events);
120     if(!state.managed) return {consistent:true,managed:false};
121     const documents={},prefixStates=new Map();
122     for(const [name,key] of Object.entries(DOCS)) {
123       const current=readDocument(root,name), parts=splitManaged(current.baseline,key);
124       const desired=renderRefinementDocument(state,name);
125       if(parts.absent) {
126         const baseline=state.adoption.documents[name];
127         // Initial publication can replay only against the exact source baseline.
128         if(current.exists!==baseline.exists || current.baseline!==baseline.baseline) return {consistent:false,error:'managed-content-conflict',document:name};
129         // Once a later operation exists, lost markers cannot be mistaken for first adopt.
130         if(roadmap.roadmap_events.filter(e=>e.kind==='refinement_update').length>1) return {consistent:false,error:'managed-content-conflict',document:name};
131         documents[name]='unpublished';
132       } else if(parts.region===desired) documents[name]='current';
133       else if(matchesHistoricalRegion(roadmap.roadmap_events,name,parts.region,state,prefixStates)) documents[name]='lagging';
134       else return {consistent:false,error:'managed-content-conflict',document:name};
135     }
136     return {consistent:Object.values(documents).every(x=>x==='current'),managed:true,documents,generation:state.generation};
137   } catch(e) { return {consistent:false,error:e.code || 'backing-store-unreadable',detail:e.message}; }
138 }

140 export function publishRefinementProjections(root, roadmap) {
141   const state=foldRefinements(roadmap.roadmap_events);
142   if(!state.managed) return {consistent:true};
143   const status=refinementProjectionStatus(root,roadmap);
144   if(status.error) return {ok:false,...status};
145   const updated_documents=[];
146   for(const [name,key] of Object.entries(DOCS)) {
147     if(status.documents[name]==='current') continue;
148     const current=readDocument(root,name), parts=splitManaged(current.baseline,key);
149     const region=renderRefinementDocument(state,name);
150     const text=parts.absent ? current.baseline+(current.baseline.endsWith('\n')||!current.baseline?'':'\n')+'\n'+region+'\n' : parts.prefix+region+parts.suffix;
151     writeFileAtomicSync(contained(root,name,false),text);
152     updated_documents.push(name);
153   }
154   try {
155     const navigation=Object.fromEntries(buildRoadmapProjection(roadmap.roadmap_events).projection
156       .filter(s=>s.navigation).map(s=>[s.id,s.navigation]));
157     const finished=publishApprovedDeliverables(root,state,navigation);
158     return {ok:true,consistent:true,generation:state.generation,updated_documents,finished};
159   } catch(e) { return {ok:true,consistent:false,generation:state.generation,
160     updated_documents,
161     finished:{consistent:false,error:e.code||'approved-projection-failed',detail:e.message}}; }
162 }

164 /** Called only by the existing spine while holding roadmap.json's lock. */
165 export function prepareRefinementEvent(root, roadmap, event) {
166   try {
167     const operation=structuredClone(event.operation);
168     const state=foldRefinements(roadmap.roadmap_events);
169     if(operation.action==='adopt') {
170       if(state.managed) return fail('already-managed');
171       operation.documents=Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(DOCS).map(name=>[name,readDocument(root,name)]));
172       for(const [name,key] of Object.entries(DOCS)) if(!splitManaged(operation.documents[name].baseline,key).absent) return fail('managed-adoption-conflict');
173     } else {
174       if(!state.managed) return fail('unmanaged-campaign');
175       const status=refinementProjectionStatus(root,roadmap);
176       if(!status.consistent) return fail(status.error || 'projection-lag','Replay the committed operation before another mutation');
177     }
178     if(operation.step_id && !roadmap.roadmap_projection.some(s=>s.id===operation.step_id)) return fail('unknown-step');
179     if(operation.action==='present') {
180       if(operation.product_context!==undefined || (operation.product_context_version!==undefined && operation.product_context_version!==1))
181         return fail('invalid-product-context','The reducer derives product context; callers cannot supply its digest map.');
182       operation.product_context_version=1;
183     }
184     if(operation.action==='open_slice') {
185       const step=roadmap.roadmap_projection.find(s=>s.id===operation.step_id);
186       if(step?.component_ids?.length && operation.product_ids.some(id=>!step.component_ids.includes(id))) return fail('kickoff-product-id-mismatch');
187     }
188     if(operation.action==='visual_companion') {
189       const revision=state.slices[operation.step_id]?.revisions[operation.revision_id];
190       if(!revision || revision.hash!==operation.source_hash) return fail('preview-source-mismatch');
191       const source=contained(root,operation.preview_source_path);
192       const bytes=fs.readFileSync(source),hash=sha(bytes);
193       if(path.extname(source).toLowerCase()!=='.pdf' || !bytes.subarray(0,5).equals(Buffer.from('%PDF-')))
194         return fail('preview-must-be-pdf');
195       if(operation.preview_hash && operation.preview_hash!==hash) return fail('preview-hash-mismatch');
196       const rel=`deliverables/${revision.product_id}/${hash}.pdf`,dest=contained(root,rel,false);
197       fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true});
198       if(fs.existsSync(dest) && sha(fs.readFileSync(dest))!==hash) return fail('artifact-hash-mismatch');
199       if(!fs.existsSync(dest)) writeFileAtomicSync(dest,bytes);
200       operation.preview={path:rel,hash};
201     }
202     if(operation.action==='publish') {
203       operation.products=operation.products.map(p=>{
204         const source=contained(root,p.source_path || p.path);
205         // encoding-lint: raw-bytes — hash/copy all artifact formats without text conversion.
206         const bytes=fs.readFileSync(source), hash=sha(bytes);
207         if(p.hash && p.hash!==hash) throw Object.assign(new Error('Source bytes changed'),{code:'artifact-hash-mismatch'});
208         if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(p.product_id)) throw Object.assign(new Error('Invalid stable product ID'),{code:'invalid-product-id'});
209         const rel=`deliverables/${p.product_id}/${hash}${path.extname(source).toLowerCase()}`;
210         const dest=contained(root,rel,false);
211         fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true});
212         if(fs.existsSync(dest)) {
213           // encoding-lint: raw-bytes — immutable binary digest comparison.
214           if(sha(fs.readFileSync(dest))!==hash) throw Object.assign(new Error('Preserved revision was modified'),{code:'artifact-hash-mismatch'});
215         } else writeFileAtomicSync(dest,bytes);
216         return {...p,path:rel,hash};
217       });
218     }
219     return {ok:true,event:{...event,operation}};
220   } catch(e) { return fail(e.code || 'invalid-refinement-operation',e.message); }
221 }

223 /** Separate event warnings admitted by the normal writer from projection drift. */
224 export function refinementRoadmapStatus(roadmap) {
225   const validated=validateRoadmap(roadmap),events=roadmap.roadmap_events;
226   const issues=validated.issues || [];
227   const adoption=events.findIndex(e=>e?.kind==='refinement_update' && e.operation?.action==='adopt');
228   const boundaryValid=adoption>=0 && events[adoption].seq===adoption+1 &&
229     events[adoption].operation.expected_seq===adoption;
230   const replays=new Map();
231   const invalid_issues=issues.filter(issue=>{
232     if(!boundaryValid || !Number.isInteger(issue.at_index) || issue.at_index<0 || issue.at_index>=events.length) return true;
233     // Adoption accepted this prefix under the existing legacy writer contract.
234     // Preserve its warnings; neither repair nor read certifies it as clean.
235     if(issue.at_index<adoption) return false;
236     if(issue.code==='event_seq_break') return true;
237     let replay=replays.get(issue.at_index);
238     if(!replay) {
239       const prefix=events.slice(0,issue.at_index);
240       // Force validation, rather than the writer's client-ID retry shortcut.
241       const {client_event_id,...event}=events[issue.at_index];
242       replay=appendRoadmapEvent({...roadmap,roadmap_events:prefix,
243         roadmap_projection:buildRoadmapProjection(prefix).projection},event);
244       replays.set(issue.at_index,replay);
245     }
246     // Managed status overlays can make a writer-admitted flip warn in the full
247     // fold. Only the same warning reproduced by the normal append law is safe.
248     return !replay.ok || replay.idempotent ||
249       !replay.issues.some(candidate=>refinementDigest(candidate)===refinementDigest(issue));
250   });
251   if(adoption>=0 && !boundaryValid) invalid_issues.push({code:'adoption_sequence_mismatch',at_index:adoption});
252   return {consistent:validated.ok && invalid_issues.length===0,clean:validated.clean===true,
253     ...(validated.error ? {error:validated.error} : invalid_issues.length ? {error:'roadmap-events-invalid'} : {}),
254     ...(validated.drift ? {drift:validated.drift} : {}),issues,invalid_issues};
255 }

257 export function refinementResult(root, roadmap) {
258   const state=foldRefinements(roadmap.roadmap_events);
259   const navigation=Object.fromEntries(buildRoadmapProjection(roadmap.roadmap_events).projection
260     .filter(s=>s.navigation).map(s=>[s.id,s.navigation]));
261   const documents=refinementProjectionStatus(root,roadmap);
262   const roadmap_projection_status=refinementRoadmapStatus(roadmap);
263   const refinement_projection_status={consistent:!state.managed ||
264     (roadmap.refinement_projection!=null && refinementDigest(roadmap.refinement_projection)===refinementDigest(state))};
265   const finished=state.managed ? approvedProjectionStatus(root,state,navigation) : null;
266   return {ok:true,state,sequence:roadmap.roadmap_events.length,projection_status:documents,
267     roadmap_projection_status,refinement_projection_status,
268     consistent:roadmap_projection_status.consistent && refinement_projection_status.consistent &&
269       documents.consistent && (!finished || finished.consistent),
270     approved_products:approvedDeliverables(state,navigation),
271     current_approvals:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(state.slices).map(([id,slice])=>[id,currentProductApprovals(slice)])),
272     finished_projection:finished,
273     ...(Object.keys(navigation).length ? {navigation} : {})};
274 }

276 export function verbRefinementUpdate(opts={}) {
277   try {
278     const input=opts.refinement_operation || JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0,'utf8'));
279     if(input.action==='capabilities') return {ok:true,capabilities:{schema:REFINEMENT_SCHEMA,version:1,
280       actions:['producer_handoff','resolve_handoff','visual_companion'],
281       individual_completion:true,approved_collection:true,provisional_publish:true}};
282     const root=path.resolve(opts.project || '.');
283     const loaded=loadProjectRoadmap(root);
284     if(!loaded.ok || !loaded.exists) return fail(loaded.exists?'backing-store-unreadable':'empty-but-valid');
285     if(input.action==='read') return refinementResult(root,loaded.roadmap);
286     if(input.action==='repair') {
287       return repairRoadmapProjectionsThroughSpine(root,{timeoutMs:opts.timeoutMs});
288     }
289     if(input.action==='operation_status') {
290       const found=loaded.roadmap.roadmap_events.find(e=>e.kind==='refinement_update'&&e.operation?.operation_id===input.operation_id);
291       const result=refinementResult(root,loaded.roadmap);
292       return {...result,operation_id:input.operation_id,committed:!!found,result:found?{...result,committed:true,operation_id:input.operation_id}:undefined};
293     }
294     if(!input.operation_id || !Number.isInteger(input.expected_seq)) return fail('operation-id-and-sequence-required');
295     if(input.action==='close') {
296       // cockpit Wave B: the steward's close states the next act and the goal re-read first
297       const demand=demandClose(root,loaded.roadmap,input.step_id,input.goal_reread??null);
298       if(!demand.ok) return demand;
299     }
300     const result=appendRoadmapEventThroughSpine(root,{kind:'refinement_update',at:new Date().toISOString(),client_event_id:input.operation_id,request_digest:refinementDigest(input),operation:input},{skip_index:true});
301     if(!result.ok) return result;
302     const view=refinementResult(root,result.roadmap);
303     return {...view,committed:true,operation_id:input.operation_id,idempotent:result.idempotent};
304   } catch(e) { return fail(e.code || 'invalid-refinement-operation',e.message); }
305 }
